candidates.change_summary: Change the fee transferred to bank from FEE_AMOUNT to pot to drain entire pot to bank before paying winner, affecting resulting pot value.
Transfer fee after paying the winner instead of before, which can change pot observable if transfers fail or reorder affects state.
Set pot to refunded value instead of zero when random==0, leaving pot as leftover fee instead of clearing entirely.
Insert an extra increment of pot by the ticket amount before randomness, changing eventual pot value after play.
Change the random branch condition to trigger on random == 1 instead of 0, altering when pot is reset and thus observable pot value.
Change the required ticket amount to allow any msg.value (remove the require), affecting when pot is updated and thus play observable outcomes.
Change randomness modulus to 3 so the win condition triggers less often (random == 0 only 1/3 instead of 1/2), altering pot updates observable after play.
Change the branch condition to random == 1 so different random outcomes reset pot and alter observable state.
Transfer fee to msg.sender instead of bank, changing balances and pot behavior after play.
Set pot to TICKET_AMOUNT instead of 0 after a win, so subsequent observable pot differs.
